'''Macy Yakaro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Fringer/Legends|fringer]] who operated as a guide out of [[Salfur's Trading Post]] on the Forest Moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], and was fond of [[Cigarra/Legends|cigarras]]. He used to work on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]] as a spaceport controller, where he learned the frequencies the [[Zorbian space pirates]] used on the ''[[Skewer]]'', their [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. When a group came to Endor to track the ''Skewer'' and some of its precious and stolen cargo, Yakaro offered his services, for a fee.<ref name="Tessent" />

==Behind the scenes==
Macy Yakaro appeared in the ''[[Race for the Tessent]]'' article in [[Star Wars Gamer 9|''Star Wars Gamer'' 9]], which was released on [[March 1]], [[2002]]. The players do not need to use his services, but he increases their chances of finding the ''Skewer'' sooner. Hpwever, the longer it takes to find the ''Skewer'' increases his chances of disappearing, and ending up on a tribe of banished [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok's]] cooking spit.<ref name="Tessent" />
